needs_description: The agent is not showing demonstrations of edge-hugging navigation in situations where following a wall is the optimal way to progress. Specifically, it needs to see demonstrations where the path requires hugging the top edge (top_edge) to avoid dead-ends or wrong turns. Seeing those top-edge demonstrations would teach the agent to maintain wall contact on the outer boundary in tight corridors, helping it pick the correct turn and not backtrack. Without examples of top_edge traversal in the relevant corridor layouts, the agent may misjudge when to follow the edge versus cutting across, leading to repeated failures.
